scientific_integrity: Exact rational carry-matrix proof and independently enumerated low-bit residue checks; no external review or formal proof certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only three one-blocks with two zero gaps of length exactly one; no claim about arbitrary three-block words, other bases or strict digit-sum increase. The limiting constant 115/216 itself was evaluated by Sobolewski and Spiegelhofer; the new theorem proves its sharp finite-word lower-bound role and three-parameter monotonicity on the canonical subfamily. Potential unlocated equivalent literature remains.
title: Sharp three-block digit-sum density with single-zero separators
